summary: Specific performance of unregistered Agreement to Sell challenged after partial refund of earnest money; acceptance and encashment of refund during suit pendency; validity of unilateral cancellation; readiness and willingness of buyer; reappreciation of evidence; locus standi of appellant; bilateral agreement not unilaterally terminable; partial refund insufficient to invalidate agreement; existence of valid agreement essential for specific performance; burden of proof on plaintiff; conduct indicating lack of readiness to perform; precedent from R. Kandasamy and other SCC cases.
legal_provisions_cited: R. Kandasamy (Since Dead) & Ors. vs. T.R.K. Sarawathy & Anr., Civil Appeal No. 3015 of 2013
Mehboob-Ur-Rehman (Dead) through Legal Representatives vs. Ahsanul Ghani, (2019) 19 SCC 415
C.S. Venkatesh vs. A.S.C. Murthy (Dead) by Legal Representatives and Ors., (2020) 3 SCC 280
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgment set aside; decree for specific performance quashed; Agreement to Sell deemed unenforceable due to partial refund and lack of readiness and willingness by buyer.
